searchUrl.title: Search URL (Optional)
searchUrl.description: Direct Etsy search or category URL to scrape from. If provided, other parameters will be ignored. Example: https://www.etsy.com/c/art-and-collectibles or https://www.etsy.com/search?q=vintage

category.title: Category
category.description: Etsy category path or name (e.g., 'art-and-collectibles', '/c/jewelry', 'home-and-living'). Browse categories at https://www.etsy.com/c

searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Keywords to search for products (e.g., 'vintage prints', 'handmade jewelry', 'custom gift'). Works with or without category.

maxProducts.title: Maximum Products
maxProducts.description: Maximum number of product listings to scrape (0 = unlimited). Default is 50 for optimal performance.

minPrice.title: Minimum Price
minPrice.description: Filter products by minimum price (optional, in USD)

maxPrice.title: Maximum Price
maxPrice.description: Filter products by maximum price (optional, in USD)

enrichDetails.title: Enrich with Product Details
enrichDetails.description: Fetch additional product details from individual product pages (slower but more comprehensive data)

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for bypassing anti-bot protection. Highly recommended for reliable scraping.
